content:
Track: Introduction to Data Analysis with Python
    - Lesson 1: Python for Data Analysis: Essentials
    - Lesson 2: Working with Pandas DataFrames
    - Lesson 3: Manipulating and Cleaning Data
    - Lesson 4: Time Series Analysis using Pandas
    - Lesson 5: Introduction to NumPy and SciPy
    - Lesson 6: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) with Python
    - Lesson 7: Statistical Analysis with scipy and statsmodels
    - Lesson 8: Hypothesis Testing and Confidence Intervals
    - Lesson 9: Regression Analysis and Predictive Modeling
    - Lesson 10: Machine Learning Algorithms for Data Analysis

   Track: SQL Fundamentals
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Relational Databases
    - Lesson 2: Basic SQL SELECT Statements
    - Lesson 3: JOIN Operations: INNER, OUTER, LEFT and RIGHT JOINS
    - Lesson 4: Aggregate Functions in SQL: COUNT(), AVG(), SUM(), MIN() and MAX()
    - Lesson 5: Subqueries, Nested Queries and Correlated Subqueries
    - Lesson 6: Data Manipulation Language (DML) with INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE and MERGE Statements
    - Lesson 7: Creating and Altering Tables with SQL DDL Commands
    - Lesson 8: Views, Stored Procedures and Triggers in SQL
    - Lesson 9: SQL Transactions, Constraints and Normalization
    - Lesson 10: Advanced SQL Query Optimization Techniques

   Track: Data Visualization with Python (Part 1)
    - Lesson 1: Intro to Matplotlib and Line Charts
    - Lesson 2: Bar Graphs, Histograms and Box Plots in Matplotlib
    - Lesson 3: Scatterplots, Heatmaps and Bubble Charts in Matplotlib
    - Lesson 4: Contourfills, Streamplots and Surfaceplots in Matplotlib
    - Lesson 5: Intro to Seaborn and Visualizing Data Distributions
    - Lesson 6: Correlation Matrices, Heatmaps and Scatterplots with Seaborn
    - Lesson 7: Time Series Analysis with Matplotlib and Seaborn
    - Lesson 8: Interactive Plots using Plotly

   Track: Data Visualization with Python (Part 2)
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Dashboards with Plotly Dash
    - Lesson 2: Building Simple Interactive Dashboards in Plotly Dash
    - Lesson 3: Styling and Customizing Plots in Plotly Dash
    - Lesson 4: Deploying Plotly Dash Applications on the Web
    - Lesson 5: Real-time Data Updates with Sockets and Dash
    - Lesson 6: Collaborative Data Exploration with Sharing Dashboards
    - Lesson 7: Building a Complete Project: A Data Visualization Dashboard
    - Lesson 8: Bonus: Integrating Machine Learning Models into Dashboards
